summary: China Automotive Systems filed a Form 6-K (the US-equivalent current report for a foreign private issuer) furnishing a November 11, 2026 press release announcing preliminary record Q3 2026 EPS unit sales and board approval of a share repurchase program of up to $5 million of outstanding common shares. Repurchases may occur over the next 12 months through November 10, 2027 in open-market transactions at prevailing prices not exceeding $5.50 per share, subject to market conditions and applicable rules. No advisor, financing or structural detail was disclosed. Watch actual buyback pace versus the $5.50 cap and liquidity; the program is modest relative to market capitalization and signals valuation views rather than a control event.
